description:
We are six Computer Engineering students from Rafaela, Argentina, united by our passion for technology, innovation, and space exploration.

For the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge, we are developing a solution that transforms complex lunar data into actionable insights to help identify and evaluate potential landing sites.

Combining software engineering, data analysis, and creativity, we aim to contribute to safer and smarter lunar exploration. Six minds, one mission: helping humanity take its next steps on the Moon.
